name: Custodian Details SD 1
definition: Provides information regarding custodian service record.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: xPath to the element that is being extended.

CustodianCorporateActionRecordIdentifica.name: Custodian Corporate Action Record Identification
CustodianCorporateActionRecordIdentifica.definition: Unique identifier of a custodian corporate action record. Applicable to custodian service only.

AgreeIndicator.name: Agree Indicator
AgreeIndicator.definition: Indicates the state of the agreement of the custodian record when compared to composite record. Applicable to custodian service only.

CompletenessIndicator.name: Completeness Indicator
CompletenessIndicator.definition: Indicates state of the details of the custodian record on the system. Applicable to custodian service only.

CustodianActionIndicator.name: Custodian Action Indicator
CustodianActionIndicator.definition: Represents the status of custodian activity when applicable.

GCAActionIndicator.name: GCA Action Indicator
GCAActionIndicator.definition: Indicates what action needs to be taken by the GCA (Global Corporate Action) validation service for this particular record. Applicable to custodian service only.

ReceivingBIC.name: Receiving BIC
ReceivingBIC.definition: BIC which is configured as a recipient of the custodian record. Applicable to custodian service only.

OriginatingBIC.name: Originating BIC
OriginatingBIC.definition: BIC which is configured as a sender of the custodian record. Applicable to custodian service only.

CompositeNotInSubscriptionFlag.name: Composite Not In Subscription Flag
CompositeNotInSubscriptionFlag.definition: Indicates whether the event security of the corresponding composite record is on SOI (security of interest) subscription. Applicable to custodian service only.

RelatedCustodianMessageDetails.name: Related Custodian Message Details
RelatedCustodianMessageDetails.definition: Provides selected corporate action events message details extracted from the related custodian messages received. Applicable to custodian service only.
